profile.description: 2026 Mesa Stamp & Scrapbook Expo runs Sept. 18-19 at Mesa Convention Center. Current official programming centers on indoor shopping, workshops, classes and make-and-take crafting activities. This is not a practical fit for a full staffed inflatable carnival.

notes.subject: 2026 review — not an Adventure Zone fit
notes.body: Official 2026 Mesa Expo information confirms Sept. 18-19 at Mesa Convention Center with a program built around crafting vendors, workshops, classes, shopping and make-and-take projects. Adventure Zone Gmail shows outreach to exhibitors@scrapbookexpo.com in 2023 and 2024 with no reply found. Do not create another routine outreach draft; the event format is not a reasonable fit for a full staffed inflatable carnival.
